name: Asymmetric Choice Tautology
description: Replaced a symmetric non-zero determinant constraint with an asymmetric strictly-positive determinant constraint, paired with a free choice of edge direction. The determinant is antisymmetric and non-zero iff multipliers differ, so exactly one direction is strictly positive. This forces models to reason through the orientation logic to discover it reduces to the same symmetric inequality constraint, defeating models that rely on the algebraic square (s_u - s_v)^2 to trigger their graph-coloring templates.
